name: Jukai Forest
description: Forest from which Towashi was cleared; home of kami.

description_citations.text: "Towashi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dosan continues his prayers even as kami hatred slowly kills him.
timeline.quote: Though the kami are slowly killing him, still he continues his prayers.

citation.text: Dosan the Falling Leaf (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The kumo attack the monks' shrine, beginning the six-year Battle of Silk.
timeline.quote: Thus began the Battle of Silk, which would last six years.

citation.text: Time of Need (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Orochi warrior youths begin to question their agreement with the monks.
timeline.quote: some warrior youths began questioning that agreement.

citation.text: Kashi-Tribe Warriors (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Part of Jukai was destroyed during the soratami invasion.
timeline.quote: Part of Jukai was destroyed during the soratami invasion

citation.text: "Jukai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towashi's growth consumed the edges of Jukai and enclosed the grove of Boseiju, displacing forest kami.
timeline.quote: As Towashi's boundaries stretched outward, the city began encroaching upon the ancient Jukai Forest, gradually consuming its edges.

citation.text: "Jukai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu directs Toshi to the budoka monks, and Toshi leaves for Jukai with Kobo.
timeline.quote: So he leaves for the forest of Jukai with Hidetsugu's apprentice Kobo

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part II". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Both groups are captured by orochi in Jukai; Toshi escapes, finds Kobo dead, and rescues Michiko from sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Toshi rescues Michiko who is going to be sacrificed by the Myojin of Life's Web to stop the war.

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part III". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a cave Toshi meets Mochi and the Myojin of Night's Reach, who offers him power; he initially refuses.
timeline.quote: which he initially refuses

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part III". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kitsune and orochi battle outside the cave; Toshi kills the orochi and, blessed by the Myojin of Night's Reach, unsummons the Myojin of Life's Web.
timeline.quote: Toshi unsummons her

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part III". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi reveals Choryu killed Kobo and sends him flying away; Toshi escapes in mist.
timeline.quote: Toshi reveals that it was Choryu , not the orochi, who has killed Kobo

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part III". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Kami War the orochi refuse to take up arms against the nature spirits and let themselves be slaughtered.
timeline.quote: At first, they refused to take up arms against the nature spirits they worshipped, letting themselves be slaughtered instead.

citation.text: "Snake", section "Orochi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The construction of Towashi destroys forest and enrages the kami, who close Jukai Forest to everyone including the orochi.
timeline.quote: They drove out all who had been living within its borders and closed the forest off to everyone — including the Orochi.

citation.text: "Snake", section "Orochi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The orochi accept the kami's terms without hesitation, and the kami grant them greater power and a new form.
timeline.quote: Touched by their devotion, the kami granted the Orochi power magnitudes greater than what they had ever had before

citation.text: "Snake", section "Orochi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kobo is killed by Choryu; Toshi rescues Michiko.
timeline.quote: When Toshi awoke, he found Kobo hung between two trees, his lungs filled with water, a victim of the Minamo agent Choryu .

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mochi shows Michiko her birth night; Toshi accepts Night's Reach's blessings and defeats Life's Web, then sends Choryu to Hidetsugu.
timeline.quote: Toshi was able to defeat Life's Web using his kanji magic that had been greatly enhanced by Night's Reach.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi escapes with the disk through the shadows against the myojin's wish; the disk punctures her mask, and he loses her blessings and his kanji abilities.
timeline.quote: She fled and Toshi was spat out of the shadows bereft of the myojin's blessings and even his kanji abilities.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko touches the disk, releasing Kyodai; they merge into the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit, destroy O-Kagachi and take his place.
timeline.quote: Together, they destroyed O-Kagachi and took his place.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai turns Konda to stone and shatters him; Hidetsugu emerges merged with the oni and Mochi is eaten.
timeline.quote: Mochi was torn apart and eaten by the oni's jaws.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towashi's expansion into Jukai Forest angers the kami, who retaliate.
timeline.quote: rose from the forest depths to retaliate

citation.text: "Towashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kumo attack the monks' shrine and the Battle of Silk begins.
timeline.quote: On the fifty-seventh day of the Battle of Silk, the bell again tolled in hopes of summoning mortal aid.

citation.text: Gnarled Mass (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Michiko sends a kanji message to Toshi; Eiganjo has fallen and the soratami are conquering in Takenuma and Jukai.
timeline.quote: Eiganjo has fallen, Takeshi Konda is missing, and the soratami are conquering in the Takenuma and Jukai.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi is briefly captured by orochi led by Sosuke, and then tormented by dreams from Uyo and Chiyo confronting him with his misdeeds.
timeline.quote: calling him an oath-breaker

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Konda arrives at Jukai and the Taken One summons O-Kagachi; Toshi teleports the Taken One through Night's Reach's realm against her command.
timeline.quote: he teleports the Taken One through Night's Reach's realm

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko frees the spirit in the Taken One, who is named Kyodai; O-Kagachi manifests all eight heads.
timeline.quote: Toshi suggests " Kyodai ", meaning "sibling"

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai merge and defeat O-Kagachi, biting off his last heads; Konda is turned to stone and shattered.
timeline.quote: Konda then shows up but is quickly turned to stone and shattered

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai summons Hidetsugu, now the new chaos oni, who eats Mochi.
timeline.quote: then Hidetsugu eats Mochi

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Toshi release the Taken One in Jukai Forest; she takes the name Kyodai and binds her power with Michiko.
timeline.quote: took the name Kyodai and bound her power with Princess Michiko Konda

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai and Michiko immobilize and defeat O-Kagachi, biting off its remaining heads.
timeline.quote: bit off O-Kagachi's remaining heads, then cast the limp body aside

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eiko speaks with the Kodama of the West Tree and gains safe passage but conceals the threat of Tameshi.
timeline.quote: "She says we can pass through safely, as long as we don't go beyond the river,"

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito draws his dagger at a rock kami and Eiko scolds him for breaking the no-weapons rule.
timeline.quote: "I thought we agreed no weapons,"

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Eiko confesses she saw a light on the roof the night the emperor vanished, which exploded and became an animal.
timeline.quote: It wasn't a man—it was a light.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Eiko reconcile over Light-Paws's disbelief, and Eiko offers to bring him home.
timeline.quote: "You can still come home, you know.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Eiko turns back at the river, and Kaito crosses alone and finds Tameshi's makeshift laboratory with a caged something.
timeline.quote: Not a box—a cage . And there was something trapped inside.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Tameshi ambushes Kaito and they fight with Tameshi's origami staff; Kaito pins Tameshi's throat with the staff.
timeline.quote: until he managed to pull the rod against his opponent's throat.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Eiko stops Kaito from strangling Tameshi.
timeline.quote: "Kaito, what are you doing? Let him go!"

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Tameshi recognizes Kaito's crane drone and reveals that Katsumasa was his mentor and that they designed it together.
timeline.quote: "He was my mentor.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: The caged object turns out to be a metal tanuki robot, which Eiko recognizes as resembling the animal she saw.
timeline.quote: "This robot is almost identical to the animal I saw."

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Tameshi explains the light was a unique kami being born, embodying the emperor's bond with Kyodai, and that he built the prototype to protect it.
timeline.quote: "The light you saw was a kami being born.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito hears Kyodai's voice and runs after it hoping the emperor has returned, but finds only the tanuki-shaped kami.
timeline.quote: Instead, he saw the tanuki-shaped kami, with glowing white eyes and translucent fur.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Eiko and Tameshi argue over whether his research endangers the kami and the merge gates, and Eiko demands it be destroyed.
timeline.quote: "Your research—it needs to be destroyed."

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Five Hyozan Reckoners led by Nari arrive with Satoru's channeler, revealing they were watching Kaito and that the job was a setup to find Tameshi.
timeline.quote: He hoped you'd lead us to Tameshi."

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: A Reckoner seizes Eiko at swordpoint and Nari demands the kami.
timeline.quote: One of the Reckoners moved quickly, grabbing hold of Eiko and holding a sword against her neck.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Eiko breaks free and the siblings fight the Reckoners back to back while Tameshi fails to make the kami merge with the robot.
timeline.quote: "What happened to 'no weapons'?"

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: The Order of Jukai arrives and battles the Reckoners, letting the group escape with the kami.
timeline.quote: The Order of Jukai had arrived.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Gravelighter attacks the fleeing group; Kaito shields Eiko and Himoto, and Himoto commands Gravelighter to retreat.
timeline.quote: No—not a cry. A command .

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Tameshi reveals he stalled and sent a drone to summon the Order of Jukai, and Eiko offers him a deal to abandon the research.
timeline.quote: I was stalling, waiting for the Order of Jukai to turn up.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Tameshi gives Kaito his tanuki drone and departs to clear his lab.
timeline.quote: "Take it. It's far better than that outdated crane you've been holding onto."

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Himoto refuses to go to the palace with Eiko; Kaito names her Pompon-chan and vows to find the emperor.
timeline.quote: "I vote we call her Pompon-chan for now,"

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Himoto bonds with the tanuki prototype and tells Kaito her name.
timeline.quote: "She says her name is Himoto."

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaito dons the tanuki mask and feels a surge of power, and Kaito vanishes from Kamigawa as a new planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Kaito took a step forward and vanished from Kamigawa.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Chishiro recalls letting a captured Futurist go into Jukai, as he used to do while bonded to Kaima.
timeline.quote: So, Chishiro let her go, stripped of all her technology and gear, into the depths of the forest she had sought to ravage.

citation.text: "The Blade Reflected and Reborn" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, a boy poisons Chishiro's order at their haven and demands that Kaima bond with him.
timeline.quote: "Well? You know what I want. Bond with me, and I'll have no need to kill him."

citation.text: "The Blade Reflected and Reborn" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: In the flashback, Chishiro lets Kaima go, the blade shatters, and Kaima tramples the boy and vanishes with the bond broken.
timeline.quote: The root in Chishiro's mind snapped, and the blade in the boy's hand shattered.

citation.text: "The Blade Reflected and Reborn" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Chishiro burns the bodies of his friends and the villagers and thereafter becomes a sellsword.
timeline.quote: In the end, he burned the bodies of his friends, and of every villager he could find.

citation.text: "The Blade Reflected and Reborn" by Emma Mieko Candon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Clear-cutting for Towashi made Jukai Forest hostile to outsiders.
timeline.quote: After large sections were clear-cut to build Towashi, the once-peaceful Jukai Forest grew violently hostile to outsiders.

citation.text: Invoke the Ancients (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Shigeki says the soul of Jukai reaches beyond the forest.
timeline.quote: The soul of Jukai reaches far beyond the forest's edge.

citation.text: Kodama's Reach (Neon Dynasty Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Order of Jukai was established about 1,200 years after the Kami War.
timeline.quote: the Order of Jukai was established to preserve nature and reverence for the spirits.

citation.text: "Jukai", section "The Order of Jukai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azusa left Jukai after almost eight years to explore Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: Azusa left to explore Kamigawa's corners

citation.text: "Azusa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towashi's expansion into Jukai Forest drove out kami, who attacked the new buildings.
timeline.quote: Enraged, the kami fought back, emerging from the depths of the forest to wreck the newly constructed buildings

citation.text: "Boseiju", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor brokered an agreement halting Towashi's growth into the forest and forbidding the felling of Boseiju.
timeline.quote: He brokered an agreement that the city would halt further growth into the forest.

citation.text: "Boseiju", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A young monk displaced by Towashi builds a shrine around a seed that becomes the Kami of Boundless Vigor and reclaims a section of forest.
timeline.quote: Together, the kami and monk reclaimed his section of the forest.

citation.text: "Go-Shintai of Boundless Vigor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu sends Kobo with Toshi Umezawa to Jukai for field experience.
timeline.quote: He then sent the youth with Toshi, to gain some "field experience".

citation.text: "Kobo", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi and Kobo defeat three kami minions of the Myojin of Infinite Rage.
timeline.quote: defeated three kami minions of the Myojin of Infinite Rage

citation.text: "Kobo", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orochi overwhelm Kobo with numbers and poison, and tie him to trees.
timeline.quote: he was overwhelmed by their sheer numbers and poison

citation.text: "Kobo", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Choryu drowns the helpless Kobo.
timeline.quote: The wizard Choryu abused the situation to drown Kobo

citation.text: "Kobo", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pearl-Ear witnesses O-Kagachi's appearance, the climactic battle and the Daimyo's fate.
timeline.quote: She witnessed the climactic battle above the boughs, as well as the Daimyo's ultimate fate.

citation.text: "Pearl-Ear", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Taken One punctured Konda's eyes, petrified him and crushed him into a million pieces.
timeline.quote: the Taken One punctured Konda's eyes, then petrified his immortal body and crushed him into a million pieces

citation.text: "Takeshi Konda", section "The Reckoning". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaito meets Tameshi in Jukai Forest; Tameshi becomes his mentor and best friend for nine years.
timeline.quote: Tameshi became the young planeswalker's mentor and best friend

citation.text: "Tameshi", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Jukai", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
